name: KeyframeComponent_Stop
comment: Stops the puppet track (6 slots of 0x134 bytes at puppet+8) playing this keyframe unless it is flagged persistent

name: Config_GetPath
proto: void Config_GetPath(char * name, char * buf, char * defaultSubdir)
comment: Reads a path setting from the registry (prefix g_szConfigKeyPrefix + name); falls back to GrimDataDir plus the default sub directory
Registry value name prefix for Config_GetPath / Config_SetPath

name: Lua_RunSystemScript
comment: lua_dofile('_system.lua')

name: Lua_CallSystemFunction
comment: Calls the global Lua function named by the string at 0x004ec3c8 with (flag, str)

name: Lua_CallCamChangeHandler
comment: system.camChangeHandler(from, to)

name: Lua_CallPostCamChangeHandler
comment: system.postCamChangeHandler(setup)

name: Lua_UpdateFrame
comment: Per frame: stores system.frameTime and system.movieTime, collects garbage every 10 s, runs lua_updatetasks
lua_ref of the global `system` table
Milliseconds since the last Lua garbage collection
Current movie time published as system.movieTime

name: Lua_CallCostumeMarkerHandler
comment: system.costumeMarkerHandler(actor, marker) from keyframe markers

name: Lua_CallUserPaintHandler
comment: system.userPaintHandler() after a restore

name: Lua_CallExitHandler
comment: system.exitHandler(); returns 1 when a handler existed

name: Lua_CallPauseHandler
comment: system.pauseHandler() (Pause key)

name: Lua_CallCharacterHandler
comment: system.characterHandler(char); true when the script consumed it

name: Lua_SaveUserdataHook
comment: lua_savehook: STAT userdata is written as setup<<16 | index in the setup's object state list

name: Lua_RestoreUserdataHook
comment: lua_restorehook: rebuilds STAT, FONT and TEXT userdata pointers from their saved ids

name: Lua_DispatchControlHandlers
comment: Calls system.buttonHandler / system.axisHandler for every enabled control whose state changed (last value kept at control+8)

name: Lua_CreateSystemTable
comment: Creates the global `system` table with the controls table and stub camChange/axis/button handlers; returns its ref

name: Lua_CreateControlsTable
comment: system.controls[name] = index for every entry of g_ControlTable (name at control+0xc)

name: Lua_CallSaveGameCallback
comment: system.saveGameCallback(); the script answers with SubmitSaveGameData
